rules.LOW_RESOLUTION: min_dimension strictly below the reference 5th percentile
rules.BLURRY: Laplacian variance strictly below the reference 5th percentile
rules.TOO_DARK: mean luminance strictly below the reference 5th percentile
rules.TOO_BRIGHT: mean luminance strictly above the reference 95th percentile
rules.LOW_CONTRAST: luminance standard deviation strictly below the reference 5th percentile
rules.EXTREME_ASPECT_RATIO: width/height strictly outside the reference 5th to 95th percentile
rules.EXCESSIVE_CLIPPING: near-black or near-white fraction strictly above its reference 95th percentile
rules.SUSPICIOUS_FRAMING: foreground-occupancy proxy strictly below the reference 5th percentile
rules.comparison: strict inequality, so a value equal to the percentile is not flagged
